events.title: Meet us at GameOn 26!
events.summary: We're excited to share that Skyline Sim will be at GameOn 2026 in Vilnius, Lithuania! Come say hi! Skyline Sim is an airline management simulator where you build and grow your own airline in a living world powered by real aviation data spanning 1990-2026. We're looking forward to meeting fellow developers, talking with players, and sharing what we've been working on. Whether you're into aviation, management games, or just curious about what we're building, we'd love to meet you! 📍 LITEXPO, Vilni

events.title: Skyline Sim Demo Is Out Now!
events.summary: The Skyline Sim demo is now available on Steam! Build your airline, plan routes, manage your fleet and see if you have what it takes to run a successful airline. Whether you're here to build a small regional carrier or work your way towards a major airline, we'd love to hear what you think. Give It a Try PLAY THE DEMO ON STEAM Found a bug or have an idea? Share your feedback with us and help shape the future of Skyline Sim. FEEDBACK BOARD Thanks for checking out Skyline Sim. See you in the skies

events.title: Skyline Sim: Road to Early Access
events.summary: Hey everyone! We're currently aiming to release Skyline Sim in Early Access in April 2027! After the recent playtests, we've been planning what's next for the game. Over the coming months, we'll be focusing on four main areas. Competition & AI We're improving how competing airlines make decisions, manage their fleets and networks, and react to competition.
